data.body_html:
Choosing between the Azimut 39 and the Fairline Targa 12m for your Marbella charter in 2037? Both depart from Puerto Banús, but they differ in size, capacity, and price. The Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offers a sporty flybridge and fixed pricing starting at €749 for 2 hours. The Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) has a sleek open-cockpit design, with pricing on request. Read on to compare specs, inclusions, and which boat suits your day on the Costa del Sol.

Capacity and Comfort: Which Boat Fits Your Group?

The Azimut 39 carries up to 11 passengers, making it ideal for larger groups or families. Its flybridge offers an elevated sunbathing area and panoramic views of Marbella’s coastline. The Fairline Targa 12m accommodates 10 guests and features a spacious open cockpit, perfect for sunbathing and socialising at sea level. If you have 11 guests, the Azimut 39 is your only choice. For 10 or fewer, both boats work—your preference for a flybridge or open layout will decide.

Pricing: Transparent vs Bespoke

The Azimut 39 has clear, all-inclusive pricing: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. That includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. The Fairline Targa 12m requires a custom quote via WhatsApp—perfect if you want to negotiate extras or a longer charter. Both boats offer the same inclusions, but the Azimut 39 gives you instant booking certainty.

Best Routes from Puerto Banús

Both boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s luxury scene. Popular routes include cruising to Cala del Faro (a 20-minute ride), Cala Cortés for lunch, or heading east to Cabopino for a beach club stop. The Azimut 39’s flybridge offers great photo ops of La Concha mountain. The Fairline Targa 12m’s open deck lets you feel the Mediterranean breeze up close.

Which Boat Wins for Style and Experience?

The Azimut 39 feels modern and sporty, with a raised helm and flybridge that gives a mini-superyacht vibe. The Fairline Targa 12m is sleeker and more low-profile, appealing to those who prefer a classic motorboat aesthetic. Choose Azimut if you want a commanding view; choose Fairline if you want a more intimate, open-air experience.

Availability in 2037

Both boats are available for charter from Puerto Banús throughout 2037. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance during peak season (June–September). The Azimut 39 is part of our Tier A fleet with fixed pricing, while the Fairline Targa 12m requires a WhatsApp inquiry for rates. Check our full fleet for more options.
